item.description: Where is Pennsylvania? Pennsylvania is in the Mid-Atlantic and Northeastern regions of the United States. It borders Delaware, Maryland, West Virginia, Ohio, New Jersey, and New York. Pennsylvania covers an area of 46,055 square miles.

item.title: Pennsylvania | Geography, History, Capital, Population, Map, Flag ...
item.description: Pennsylvania, constituent state of the U.S., one of the original 13 American colonies. It is bounded to the north by Lake Erie and New York; to the east by New York and New Jersey; to the south by Delaware, Maryland, and West Virginia, and to the west by West Virginia and Ohio.

item.title: History of Pennsylvania - Wikipedia
item.description: In 1681, Pennsylvania became a British colony when William Penn received a royal deed from King Charles II of England. Penn, a Quaker, established his colony based on religious tolerance. It was settled by many Quakers along with Philadelphia, its largest city, which was also the first planned city.

item.title: Pennsylvania - Simple English Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
item.description: Pennsylvania is divided into 67 counties. The state capital of Pennsylvania is Harrisburg. The largest city in Pennsylvania is Philadelphia. The state nickname of Pennsylvania is, "The Keystone State". The current governor of Pennsylvania is Josh Shapiro.
